reconstructed_steps.text: Work first over an actual smooth projective curve X over complete algebraically closed nontrivially real-valued C, V=C-circle, residue kappa. Use the ACTUAL proper semistable formal model/skeleton construction242. Let an ACTUAL formal invertible sheaf A already have generic fibre identified with the original dL. The direct route does not need to algebraize the formal carrier if these identifications have actually been constructed.

The actual affine admissible charts A_chart=V<T>/I with finitely generated I and V-flatness give flat finitely presented reductions X_n over V/a^n by242 A3. Their properness follows from the proper residue curve and Stacks37.3.4(8) on arbitrary nil thickenings. Spec(V/a^n) has one prime; its nilradical is generally not nilpotent of bounded order.

If EVERY residual component degree of A is strictly positive, the line bundle on the actual proper nodal residue curve is ample (Stacks33.44.15). Thickening invariance of ampleness (37.50.3/37.3.2) applies to the ENTIRE X_1 modulo a, without bounding nilpotence. One must use the corrected ENTIRE235 positive-vertex mixture and upward bends BEFORE fixing the final model; reference-only mixing does not make a newly added zero-degree component positive.

Descend the actual proper flat finitely presented pair (X_1,A_1) to a finite-Z-algebra R0 contained in V/a. Enlarge the index until properness, flatness, finite presentation and relative ampleness all hold, using the precise Stacks limits results listed in238. R0 is Noetherian because it is finite type over Z; V/a is not declared Noetherian. Relative Serre generation and vanishing for all sufficiently high k on this descended pair give a finite generating family and H^i(X_R0,A_R0^k)=0 for every i>0.

Explain base change rather than merely quoting vanishing over R0. A finite affine cover of the separated proper flat R0-scheme and its intersections gives a nonnegative Cech complex of flat R0-modules for the invertible sheaf. Hence its derived global sections have no negative cohomology after tensoring with ANY R0-module. Proper-flat-perfect cohomology (Stacks36.30.4) and the chosen total higher vanishing make this complex H0 in degree0. Therefore H0 is flat: all negative Tor vanish. It is finite projective, so derived base change (36.32.4) to R1=V/a remains concentrated in degree0. This proves WHOLE mod-a H1=0. Pull back the finite generating sections; generation is preserved by arbitrary base change. Alternatively use the full fibrewise cohomology-and-base-change theorem with uniform relative Serre vanishing, with its hypotheses explicit.

Use native243 Proposition13, reconstructed in full: flatness and local freeness identify a^r A^k/a^(r+1)A^k with A_1^k. H1 on WHOLE mod-a implies surjectivity of successive H0 reductions. Lift the finitely many generators compatibly. Global sections commute with the inverse limit of the complete local sheaves. At a local frame, repeat mod-a division of the error to sum convergent coefficients and prove actual formal generation. No carrier algebraization or Noetherian Nakayama assertion on V/a is used.

The lifted formal global sections are analytic global sections on the ALREADY identified original X^an and dL^k. Projective FIELD H0 GAGA from244 makes these algebraic sections of that same actual bundle. In a formal frame each coefficient f_i is bounded by1, and formal generation supplies integral b_i with1=sum b_i f_i. Thus max_i |f_i(x)|=1 at EVERY actual analytic point. The formal metric equals the pure FS metric of this finite algebraic section family with zero weights; divide by kd. This discharges the cohomology and field-GAGA premises of243 Proposition13 once F1-F5 are applied to a constructed pair.

Actual initial SAME-BUNDLE extension can be built from the adapted finite classical divisor of a meromorphic section sigma of dL, using242 A5-A8. To make the horizontal divisor step concrete: around a puncture choose a smooth formal relative-coordinate chart t, and set tau=t-t(p) for its bounded V-valued section. Shrink the residual open so its zero fibre has only that smooth point. For EVERY n the zero locus is an etale finitely presented V/a^n-scheme with residue fibre one kappa-point; thickening properness gives properness, proper quasi-finite implies finite, and finite etale degree1 gives V/a^n. The compatible ideals are locally (tau), a nonzerodivisor by the smooth relative-coordinate chart. Their inverse limits are formal Cartier ideals with unit transitions and the precise generic section p. The signed sum gives O(closure(div(sigma))) with generic dL. The chart shrinking/etaleness/finite step and every compatibility still require full written application and source checking; this is an unreviewed proof route, not a hidden grant.

Once the horizontal extension and the241 vertical twist represent an already genuine equal-weight pure FS reference theta exactly, global generation of THAT reference formal bundle may be checked directly. On a reduced semistable affine chart, BPR4.2(3) identifies the ring with powerbounded generic functions. Each original defining algebraic section coefficient has norm<=1 because the constructed formal metric is EXACTLY theta, hence extends integrally. The coefficients agree on overlaps by the injective generic localization. If all reduce to zero at a closed residual point, the nonempty actual reduction tube has all finite coefficient norms<1, contradicting the FS identity max norm=1. The residual finite-type curve is Jacobson, so there is no residual common zero. On each reduction modulo a, the remaining maximal-ideal coefficients form a NIL ideal, even without bounded nilpotence: an identity1=sum b_i f_i+c with c in that ideal makes1-c a unit. Adic lifting then proves formal generation. This establishes nonnegative component degrees for the reference without assuming the unknown target equation; the raw MA/component-degree identity remains separately required.

For a constructed signed horizontal divisor, its total residual component degree equals its classical generic degree, because each adapted simple horizontal section contributes one to exactly one smooth residual component. The global vertical Cartier twist changes degrees by outgoing slopes whose total over all endpoints is zero, including loops. This gives the correct total degree without assuming arbitrary graph curvature already lies in the actual MA image. Residual-degree and actual RAW operator identification must still be tied to an appropriate formal-model intersection theorem, not inferred solely from nonnegativity.

After F1-F10 supply actual same-bundle FS approximants and raw curvature, the uniform positive-graph approximation gives a genuine continuous psh atomic inverse metric by accepted O. Apply the full actual kernel/net/terminal-point and every-solution argument of235/241, with genuine continuous kernel differences recognized BEFORE O integration. Only then use240 finite actual Galois orbit from an invariant pure-FS measure support and a FINITE CONTINUOUS atom average to descend a norming atom via D/N. This remains a route to a new unconditional all-genus curve theorem, not yet a theorem of this record.
